CREATE TABLE "capability_templates" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "description" TEXT,
  "capability" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "scripts_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  "hooks_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  "param_schema_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  "param_defaults_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  "agent_by_slot_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  "prompt_by_slot_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  "params_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  "stage_contract_ver" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  "upstream_id" TEXT,
  "upstream_version" INTEGER,
  "base_digest" TEXT,
  "base_snapshot_json" TEXT,
  "owner_user_id" TEXT,
  "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'public',
  "acl_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "builtin" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "capability_templates_visibility_enum" CHECK ("visibility" IN ('public','private')),
  CONSTRAINT "capability_templates_visibility_codec" CHECK ("visibility" IN ('public', 'private')),
  CONSTRAINT "capability_templates_builtin_codec" CHECK ("builtin" IN (0, 1))
)

CREATE TABLE "repo_capability_config" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "repo_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "capability" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "template_id" TEXT,
  "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "trigger_config_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  "readiness" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'disabled',
  "readiness_issues_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  "dependency_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "last_validated_at" INTEGER,
  "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "repo_capability_config_enabled_boolean" CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)),
  CONSTRAINT "repo_capability_config_readiness_enum" CHECK ("readiness" IN ('disabled','misconfigured','ready')),
  CONSTRAINT "repo_capability_config_enabled_codec" CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)),
  CONSTRAINT "repo_capability_config_readiness_codec" CHECK ("readiness" IN ('disabled', 'misconfigured', 'ready'))
)

CREATE TABLE "code_history_archives" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "format_version" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "source_contract" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "source_generation" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "source_table" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "row_count" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "root_digest" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "content_ref_json" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "content_inline_bytes" BLOB,
  CONSTRAINT "code_history_archives_source" UNIQUE ("source_generation", "source_contract", "source_table"),
  CONSTRAINT "code_history_archives_content_ref_json_codec" CHECK (("content_ref_json" IS NULL AND "content_inline_bytes" IS NULL) OR (json_valid("content_ref_json") AND json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.version') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.kind') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.version') = 1 AND ((json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.kind') = 'inline' AND "content_inline_bytes" IS NOT NULL) OR (json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.kind') IN ('local-file', 'database-bytes', 'object') AND "content_inline_bytes" IS NULL))))
)

CREATE TABLE "code_history_id_index" (
  "source_table" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "original_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "source_contract" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "archive_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "original_key_json" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "record_ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("source_table", "original_id", "source_contract"),
  CONSTRAINT "code_history_id_index_archive_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("archive_id") REFERENCES "code_history_archives" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION
)

CREATE TABLE "review_node_reviewers" (
  "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "review_node_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "reviewer_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "assigned_by_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "assigned_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "review_node_id", "reviewer_user_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "review_node_reviewers_task_id_tasks_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("task_id") REFERENCES "tasks" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT "review_node_reviewers_reviewer_user_id_users_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("reviewer_user_id") REFERENCES "users" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT "review_node_reviewers_assigned_by_user_id_users_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("assigned_by_user_id") REFERENCES "users" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE "task_feedback" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "author_user_id" TEXT,
  "body_md" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "distilled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "distill_job_id" TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE "task_questions" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "origin_node_run_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "question_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "question_title" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "source_kind" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "role_kind" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "iteration" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "loop_iter" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "default_target_node_id" TEXT,
  "override_target_node_id" TEXT,
  "dispatched_at" INTEGER,
  "dispatched_by" TEXT,
  "trigger_run_id" TEXT,
  "staged_at" INTEGER,
  "staged_by" TEXT,
  "auto_dispatch_deferred_at" INTEGER,
  "sealed_at" INTEGER,
  "sealed_by" TEXT,
  "confirmation" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
  "confirmed_by" TEXT,
  "confirmed_by_role" TEXT,
  "confirmed_at" INTEGER,
  "last_reassigned_by" TEXT,
  "last_reassigned_at" INTEGER,
  "manual_body" TEXT,
  "manual_created_by" TEXT,
  "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT ((unixepoch() * 1000)),
  "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT ((unixepoch() * 1000)),
  CONSTRAINT "task_questions_source_kind_codec" CHECK ("source_kind" IN ('self', 'cross', 'manual')),
  CONSTRAINT "task_questions_role_kind_codec" CHECK ("role_kind" IN ('self', 'questioner', 'designer')),
  CONSTRAINT "task_questions_confirmation_codec" CHECK ("confirmation" IN ('open', 'confirmed')),
  CONSTRAINT "task_questions_task_id_tasks_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("task_id") REFERENCES "tasks" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE "clarify_rounds" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "kind" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "asking_node_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "asking_node_run_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "asking_shard_key" TEXT,
  "intermediary_node_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "intermediary_node_run_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "target_consumer_node_id" TEXT,
  "loop_iter" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "container_run_id" TEXT,
  "iteration" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "questions_json" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "directive" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'awaiting_human',
  "truncation_warnings_json" TEXT,
  "designer_run_triggered_at" INTEGER,
  "abandoned_at" INTEGER,
  "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT ((unixepoch() * 1000)),
  "answered_at" INTEGER,
  "answered_by" TEXT,
  "submitted_by_role" TEXT,
  "questions_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  "sealed_question_set_key" TEXT,
  "answers_recorded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "drafts_recorded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "attributions_recorded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "legacy_answers_json" TEXT,
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_rounds_kind_enum" CHECK ("kind" IN ('self', 'cross')),
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_rounds_directive_enum" CHECK ("directive" IS NULL OR "directive" IN ('continue', 'stop')),
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_rounds_status_enum" CHECK ("status" IN ('awaiting_human', 'answered', 'canceled', 'abandoned')),
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_rounds_kind_shape" CHECK (("kind" = 'self' AND "status" != 'abandoned') OR ("kind" = 'cross' AND "status" != 'canceled')),
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_rounds_kind_codec" CHECK ("kind" IN ('self', 'cross')),
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_rounds_directive_codec" CHECK ("directive" IN ('continue', 'stop')),
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_rounds_status_codec" CHECK ("status" IN ('awaiting_human', 'answered', 'canceled', 'abandoned')),
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_rounds_answers_recorded_codec" CHECK ("answers_recorded" IN (0, 1)),
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_rounds_drafts_recorded_codec" CHECK ("drafts_recorded" IN (0, 1)),
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_rounds_attributions_recorded_codec" CHECK ("attributions_recorded" IN (0, 1)),
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_rounds_task_id_tasks_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("task_id") REFERENCES "tasks" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_rounds_asking_node_run_id_node_runs_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("asking_node_run_id") REFERENCES "node_runs" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_rounds_intermediary_node_run_id_node_runs_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("intermediary_node_run_id") REFERENCES "node_runs" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE "clarify_answers" (
  "round_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "question_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "occurrence" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  "questions_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("round_id", "question_id", "occurrence"),
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_answers_order" UNIQUE ("round_id", "ordinal"),
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_answers_round_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("round_id") REFERENCES "clarify_rounds" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE "clarify_answer_drafts" (
  "round_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "question_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "occurrence" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  "questions_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("round_id", "question_id", "occurrence"),
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_answer_drafts_order" UNIQUE ("round_id", "ordinal"),
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_answer_drafts_round_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("round_id") REFERENCES "clarify_rounds" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE "clarify_answer_attributions" (
  "round_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "question_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "occurrence" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("round_id", "question_id", "occurrence"),
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_answer_attributions_order" UNIQUE ("round_id", "ordinal"),
  CONSTRAINT "clarify_answer_attributions_round_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("round_id") REFERENCES "clarify_rounds" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE "collaboration_gate_operations" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "gate_kind" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "operation_kind" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "gate_ref" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "idempotency_key" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "request_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "actor_user_id" TEXT,
  "expected_task_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "expected_gate_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "result_gate_revision" INTEGER,
  "state" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "claim_epoch" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "claim_expires_at" INTEGER,
  "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  "manifest_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  "receipt_json" TEXT,
  "failure_json" TEXT,
  "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "committed_at" INTEGER,
  "completed_at" INTEGER,
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_task_revision_nonnegative" CHECK ("expected_task_revision" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_gate_revision_nonnegative" CHECK ("expected_gate_revision" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_result_revision_next" CHECK ("result_gate_revision" IS NULL OR "result_gate_revision" = "expected_gate_revision" + 1),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_claim_epoch_nonnegative" CHECK ("claim_epoch" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_schema_version_positive" CHECK ("schema_version" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_manifest_json_valid" CHECK (json_valid("manifest_json")),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_receipt_json_valid" CHECK ("receipt_json" IS NULL OR json_valid("receipt_json")),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_failure_json_valid" CHECK ("failure_json" IS NULL OR json_valid("failure_json")),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_committed_shape" CHECK ("state" <> 'committed' OR ("result_gate_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "receipt_json" IS NOT NULL AND "committed_at" IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_completed_shape" CHECK ("state" <> 'completed' OR ("failure_json" IS NOT NULL OR ("result_gate_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "receipt_json" IS NOT NULL AND "committed_at" IS NOT NULL))),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_failed_shape" CHECK ("state" <> 'failed' OR "failure_json" IS NOT NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_gate_kind_enum" CHECK ("gate_kind" IN ('review','clarify','questions')),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_operation_kind_enum" CHECK ("operation_kind" IN ('open','decide','manual-question-open','legacy-seed')),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_state_enum" CHECK ("state" IN ('preparing','prepared','committed','cleanup_pending','completed','failed')),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_gate_kind_codec" CHECK ("gate_kind" IN ('review', 'clarify', 'questions')),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_operation_kind_codec" CHECK ("operation_kind" IN ('open', 'decide', 'manual-question-open', 'legacy-seed')),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_state_codec" CHECK ("state" IN ('preparing', 'prepared', 'committed', 'cleanup_pending', 'completed', 'failed')),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_operations_task_id_tasks_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("task_id") REFERENCES "tasks" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE "task_collaborators" (
  "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "role" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "added_by" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "added_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "user_id", "role"),
  CONSTRAINT "task_collaborators_role_codec" CHECK ("role" IN ('owner', 'collaborator', 'observer')),
  CONSTRAINT "task_collaborators_task_id_tasks_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("task_id") REFERENCES "tasks" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT "task_collaborators_user_id_users_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES "users" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT "task_collaborators_added_by_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("added_by") REFERENCES "users" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION
)

CREATE TABLE "doc_versions" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "review_node_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "review_node_run_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "source_node_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "source_port_name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "version_index" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "review_iteration" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "comments_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  "decision" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  "decision_reason" TEXT,
  "prompt_snapshot" TEXT,
  "source_file_path" TEXT,
  "item_index" INTEGER,
  "selection" TEXT,
  "item_path" TEXT,
  "selection_stale" INTEGER,
  "round_generation" INTEGER,
  "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT ((unixepoch() * 1000)),
  "decided_at" INTEGER,
  "decided_by" TEXT,
  "decided_by_role" TEXT,
  "content_ref_json" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "content_inline_bytes" BLOB,
  CONSTRAINT "doc_versions_decision_codec" CHECK ("decision" IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'iterated', 'superseded')),
  CONSTRAINT "doc_versions_selection_codec" CHECK ("selection" IN ('unselected', 'accepted', 'not_accepted')),
  CONSTRAINT "doc_versions_selection_stale_codec" CHECK ("selection_stale" IN (0, 1)),
  CONSTRAINT "doc_versions_content_ref_json_codec" CHECK (("content_ref_json" IS NULL AND "content_inline_bytes" IS NULL) OR (json_valid("content_ref_json") AND json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.version') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.kind') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.version') = 1 AND ((json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.kind') = 'inline' AND "content_inline_bytes" IS NOT NULL) OR (json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.kind') IN ('local-file', 'database-bytes', 'object') AND "content_inline_bytes" IS NULL)))),
  CONSTRAINT "doc_versions_task_id_tasks_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("task_id") REFERENCES "tasks" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT "doc_versions_review_node_run_id_node_runs_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("review_node_run_id") REFERENCES "node_runs" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE "review_comments" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "doc_version_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "anchor_section_path" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "anchor_paragraph_idx" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "anchor_offset_start" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "anchor_offset_end" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "selected_text" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context_before" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context_after" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "occurrence_index" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "author" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local',
  "author_role" TEXT,
  "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT ((unixepoch() * 1000)),
  "content_ref_json" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "content_inline_bytes" BLOB,
  CONSTRAINT "review_comments_content_ref_json_codec" CHECK (("content_ref_json" IS NULL AND "content_inline_bytes" IS NULL) OR (json_valid("content_ref_json") AND json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.version') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.kind') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.version') = 1 AND ((json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.kind') = 'inline' AND "content_inline_bytes" IS NOT NULL) OR (json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.kind') IN ('local-file', 'database-bytes', 'object') AND "content_inline_bytes" IS NULL)))),
  CONSTRAINT "review_comments_doc_version_id_doc_versions_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("doc_version_id") REFERENCES "doc_versions" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE "collaboration_gate_artifacts" (
  "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "artifact_key" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "artifact_kind" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "byte_size" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "state" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "receipt_json" TEXT,
  "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "staged_content_ref_json" TEXT,
  "staged_inline_bytes" BLOB,
  "final_content_key" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "content_ref_json" TEXT,
  "content_inline_bytes" BLOB,
  PRIMARY KEY ("operation_id", "artifact_key"),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_artifacts_byte_size_nonnegative" CHECK ("byte_size" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_artifacts_receipt_json_valid" CHECK ("receipt_json" IS NULL OR json_valid("receipt_json")),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_artifacts_artifact_kind_fixed" CHECK ("artifact_kind" = 'review-doc'),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_artifacts_state_enum" CHECK ("state" IN ('declared','staged','consumed','finalized','cleanup_pending')),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_artifacts_artifact_kind_codec" CHECK ("artifact_kind" IN ('review-doc')),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_artifacts_state_codec" CHECK ("state" IN ('declared', 'staged', 'consumed', 'finalized', 'cleanup_pending')),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_artifacts_staged_content_ref_json_codec" CHECK (("staged_content_ref_json" IS NULL AND "staged_inline_bytes" IS NULL) OR (json_valid("staged_content_ref_json") AND json_extract("staged_content_ref_json", '$.version') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract("staged_content_ref_json", '$.kind') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract("staged_content_ref_json", '$.version') = 1 AND ((json_extract("staged_content_ref_json", '$.kind') = 'inline' AND "staged_inline_bytes" IS NOT NULL) OR (json_extract("staged_content_ref_json", '$.kind') IN ('local-file', 'database-bytes', 'object') AND "staged_inline_bytes" IS NULL)))),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_artifacts_content_ref_json_codec" CHECK (("content_ref_json" IS NULL AND "content_inline_bytes" IS NULL) OR (json_valid("content_ref_json") AND json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.version') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.kind') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.version') = 1 AND ((json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.kind') = 'inline' AND "content_inline_bytes" IS NOT NULL) OR (json_extract("content_ref_json", '$.kind') IN ('local-file', 'database-bytes', 'object') AND "content_inline_bytes" IS NULL)))),
  CONSTRAINT "collaboration_gate_artifacts_operation_id_collaboration_gate_operations_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("operation_id") REFERENCES "collaboration_gate_operations" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE "action_template_revisions" (
  "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "content_json" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "content_digest" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "published_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "published_by" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("template_id", "revision"),
  CONSTRAINT "action_template_revisions_template_id_action_templates_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("template_id") REFERENCES "action_templates" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION
)

CREATE TABLE "action_templates" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "draft_json" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "published_revision" INTEGER,
  "owner_user_id" TEXT,
  "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'private',
  "acl_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "archived_at" INTEGER,
  "capability_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "action_templates_visibility_codec" CHECK ("visibility" IN ('private', 'public'))
)

CREATE TABLE "automation_policies" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "draft_json" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "published_revision" INTEGER,
  "owner_user_id" TEXT,
  "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'private',
  "acl_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "archived_at" INTEGER,
  CONSTRAINT "automation_policies_visibility_codec" CHECK ("visibility" IN ('private', 'public'))
)

CREATE TABLE "automation_policy_revisions" (
  "policy_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "content_json" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "content_digest" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "published_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "published_by" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("policy_id", "revision"),
  CONSTRAINT "automation_policy_revisions_policy_id_automation_policies_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("policy_id") REFERENCES "automation_policies" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION
)

CREATE TABLE "development_action_runs" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "mission_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "mission_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "decision_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "capability_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "capability_contract_version" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "template_id" TEXT,
  "template_revision" INTEGER,
  "work_set_digest" TEXT,
  "input_fact_digest" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "baseline_ref" TEXT,
  "writable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "result_ref" TEXT,
  "failure_json" TEXT,
  "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "settled_at" INTEGER,
  CONSTRAINT "development_action_runs_mission_id_development_missions_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("mission_id") REFERENCES "development_missions" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION
)

CREATE TABLE "development_adapter_definition_revisions" (
  "adapter_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "content_json" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "content_digest" TEXT NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE "mcp_runtime_test_sessions" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "mcp_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "owner_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "client_create_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "client_create_digest" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "end_reason" TEXT,
  "mcp_config_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "runtime_row_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "runtime_name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "runtime_protocol" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "runtime_snapshot_json" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "runtime_binary_path" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "runtime_session_id" TEXT,
  "native_session_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  "in_flight_turn_id" TEXT,
  "turn_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "session_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "idle_deadline_at" INTEGER,
  "continuation_blocked_reason" TEXT,
  "scratch_root" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "cleanup_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not-started',
  "cleanup_error_code" TEXT,
  "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "ended_at" INTEGER,
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_status_shape" CHECK ((
        (
          "status" = 'active'
          AND "end_reason" IS NULL
          AND "ended_at" IS NULL
          AND (
            ("in_flight_turn_id" IS NOT NULL AND "idle_deadline_at" IS NULL)
            OR
            (
              "in_flight_turn_id" IS NULL
              AND "idle_deadline_at" IS NOT NULL
              AND "native_session_state" = 'ready'
              AND "continuation_blocked_reason" IS NULL
            )
          )
        )
        OR
        (
          "status" = 'ending'
          AND "end_reason" IS NOT NULL
          AND "ended_at" IS NULL
          AND "idle_deadline_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "status" = 'ended'
          AND "end_reason" IS NOT NULL
          AND "ended_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "in_flight_turn_id" IS NULL
          AND "idle_deadline_at" IS NULL
        )
      )),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_hash_shape" CHECK (length("client_create_digest") = 64
        AND "client_create_digest" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        AND length("mcp_config_hash") = 64
        AND "mcp_config_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_enum_shape" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'ending', 'ended')
        AND "runtime_protocol" IN ('opencode', 'claude-code')
        AND "native_session_state" IN ('pending', 'ready', 'unusable')
        AND "cleanup_state" IN ('not-started', 'pending', 'complete', 'quarantined')
        AND (
          "end_reason" IS NULL
          OR "end_reason" IN (
            'user', 'idle-timeout', 'mcp-deleted', 'mcp-disabled',
            'mcp-config-changed', 'access-revoked', 'runtime-disabled',
            'runtime-deleted', 'runtime-profile-changed',
            'runtime-session-reset', 'capture-truncated',
            'capture-incomplete', 'session-unusable'
          )
        )
        AND (
          "continuation_blocked_reason" IS NULL
          OR "continuation_blocked_reason" IN (
            'mcp-config-changed', 'runtime-profile-changed',
            'capture-truncated', 'capture-incomplete'
          )
        )
        AND "turn_seq" >= 0
        AND "session_version" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_status_codec" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'ending', 'ended')),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_end_reason_codec" CHECK ("end_reason" IN ('user', 'idle-timeout', 'mcp-deleted', 'mcp-disabled', 'mcp-config-changed', 'access-revoked', 'runtime-disabled', 'runtime-deleted', 'runtime-profile-changed', 'runtime-session-reset', 'capture-truncated', 'capture-incomplete', 'session-unusable')),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_runtime_protocol_codec" CHECK ("runtime_protocol" IN ('opencode', 'claude-code')),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_native_session_state_codec" CHECK ("native_session_state" IN ('pending', 'ready', 'unusable')),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_continuation_blocked_reason_codec" CHECK ("continuation_blocked_reason" IN ('mcp-config-changed', 'runtime-profile-changed', 'capture-truncated', 'capture-incomplete')),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_cleanup_state_codec" CHECK ("cleanup_state" IN ('not-started', 'pending', 'complete', 'quarantined')),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_mcp_id_mcps_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("mcp_id") REFERENCES "mcps" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_owner_user_id_users_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("owner_user_id") REFERENCES "users" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE "mcp_runtime_test_turns" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "client_message_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "prompt_text" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "hard_deadline_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "capture_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'live',
  "capture_incomplete_reason" TEXT,
  "capture_first_event_seq" INTEGER,
  "capture_last_event_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "capture_event_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "cancel_requested_at" INTEGER,
  "pid" INTEGER,
  "spawned_at" INTEGER,
  "spawn_binary_path" TEXT,
  "exit_code" INTEGER,
  "failure_code" TEXT,
  "stderr_tail" TEXT,
  "duration_ms" INTEGER,
  "started_at" INTEGER,
  "finished_at" INTEGER,
  "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_turns_enum_shape" CHECK ("status" IN (
          'queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed',
          'canceled', 'timed_out', 'interrupted'
        )
        AND "capture_state" IN ('live', 'complete', 'truncated', 'incomplete')
        AND (
          "capture_incomplete_reason" IS NULL
          OR "capture_incomplete_reason" IN (
            'stream-persist-failed', 'stream-frame-limit-exceeded',
            'child-capture-failed', 'post-exit-flush-timeout'
          )
        )),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_turns_counter_shape" CHECK ("seq" > 0
        AND "hard_deadline_at" >= "created_at"
        AND "capture_last_event_seq" >= 0
        AND "capture_event_bytes" >= 0
        AND ("capture_first_event_seq" IS NULL OR "capture_first_event_seq" > 0)
        AND ("duration_ms" IS NULL OR "duration_ms" >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_turns_lifecycle_shape" CHECK ((
          "status" = 'queued'
          AND "started_at" IS NULL
          AND "finished_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR (
          "status" = 'running'
          AND "started_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "finished_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR (
          "status" IN (
            'succeeded', 'failed', 'canceled', 'timed_out', 'interrupted'
          )
          AND "finished_at" IS NOT NULL
        )),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_turns_status_codec" CHECK ("status" IN ('queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'canceled', 'timed_out', 'interrupted')),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_turns_capture_state_codec" CHECK ("capture_state" IN ('live', 'complete', 'truncated', 'incomplete')),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_turns_session_id_mcp_runtime_test_sessions_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("session_id") REFERENCES "mcp_runtime_test_sessions" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE
)

)

CREATE TABLE "mcp_runtime_test_sessions" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "mcp_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "owner_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "client_create_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "client_create_digest" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "end_reason" TEXT,
  "mcp_config_hash" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "runtime_row_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "runtime_name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "runtime_protocol" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "runtime_snapshot_json" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "runtime_binary_path" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "runtime_session_id" TEXT,
  "native_session_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  "in_flight_turn_id" TEXT,
  "turn_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "session_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "idle_deadline_at" INTEGER,
  "continuation_blocked_reason" TEXT,
  "scratch_root" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "cleanup_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not-started',
  "cleanup_error_code" TEXT,
  "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "ended_at" INTEGER,
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_status_shape" CHECK ((
        (
          "status" = 'active'
          AND "end_reason" IS NULL
          AND "ended_at" IS NULL
          AND (
            ("in_flight_turn_id" IS NOT NULL AND "idle_deadline_at" IS NULL)
            OR
            (
              "in_flight_turn_id" IS NULL
              AND "idle_deadline_at" IS NOT NULL
              AND "native_session_state" = 'ready'
              AND "continuation_blocked_reason" IS NULL
            )
          )
        )
        OR
        (
          "status" = 'ending'
          AND "end_reason" IS NOT NULL
          AND "ended_at" IS NULL
          AND "idle_deadline_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "status" = 'ended'
          AND "end_reason" IS NOT NULL
          AND "ended_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "in_flight_turn_id" IS NULL
          AND "idle_deadline_at" IS NULL
        )
      )),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_hash_shape" CHECK (length("client_create_digest") = 64
        AND "client_create_digest" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'
        AND length("mcp_config_hash") = 64
        AND "mcp_config_hash" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_enum_shape" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'ending', 'ended')
        AND "runtime_protocol" IN ('opencode', 'claude-code')
        AND "native_session_state" IN ('pending', 'ready', 'unusable')
        AND "cleanup_state" IN ('not-started', 'pending', 'complete', 'quarantined')
        AND (
          "end_reason" IS NULL
          OR "end_reason" IN (
            'user', 'idle-timeout', 'mcp-deleted', 'mcp-disabled',
            'mcp-config-changed', 'access-revoked', 'runtime-disabled',
            'runtime-deleted', 'runtime-profile-changed',
            'runtime-session-reset', 'capture-truncated',
            'capture-incomplete', 'session-unusable'
          )
        )
        AND (
          "continuation_blocked_reason" IS NULL
          OR "continuation_blocked_reason" IN (
            'mcp-config-changed', 'runtime-profile-changed',
            'capture-truncated', 'capture-incomplete'
          )
        )
        AND "turn_seq" >= 0
        AND "session_version" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_status_codec" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'ending', 'ended')),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_end_reason_codec" CHECK ("end_reason" IN ('user', 'idle-timeout', 'mcp-deleted', 'mcp-disabled', 'mcp-config-changed', 'access-revoked', 'runtime-disabled', 'runtime-deleted', 'runtime-profile-changed', 'runtime-session-reset', 'capture-truncated', 'capture-incomplete', 'session-unusable')),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_runtime_protocol_codec" CHECK ("runtime_protocol" IN ('opencode', 'claude-code')),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_native_session_state_codec" CHECK ("native_session_state" IN ('pending', 'ready', 'unusable')),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_continuation_blocked_reason_codec" CHECK ("continuation_blocked_reason" IN ('mcp-config-changed', 'runtime-profile-changed', 'capture-truncated', 'capture-incomplete')),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_cleanup_state_codec" CHECK ("cleanup_state" IN ('not-started', 'pending', 'complete', 'quarantined')),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_mcp_id_mcps_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("mcp_id") REFERENCES "mcps" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_sessions_owner_user_id_users_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("owner_user_id") REFERENCES "users" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE "mcp_runtime_test_turns" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "client_message_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "prompt_text" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "hard_deadline_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "capture_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'live',
  "capture_incomplete_reason" TEXT,
  "capture_first_event_seq" INTEGER,
  "capture_last_event_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "capture_event_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "cancel_requested_at" INTEGER,
  "pid" INTEGER,
  "spawned_at" INTEGER,
  "spawn_binary_path" TEXT,
  "exit_code" INTEGER,
  "failure_code" TEXT,
  "stderr_tail" TEXT,
  "duration_ms" INTEGER,
  "started_at" INTEGER,
  "finished_at" INTEGER,
  "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_turns_enum_shape" CHECK ("status" IN (
          'queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed',
          'canceled', 'timed_out', 'interrupted'
        )
        AND "capture_state" IN ('live', 'complete', 'truncated', 'incomplete')
        AND (
          "capture_incomplete_reason" IS NULL
          OR "capture_incomplete_reason" IN (
            'stream-persist-failed', 'stream-frame-limit-exceeded',
            'child-capture-failed', 'post-exit-flush-timeout'
          )
        )),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_turns_counter_shape" CHECK ("seq" > 0
        AND "hard_deadline_at" >= "created_at"
        AND "capture_last_event_seq" >= 0
        AND "capture_event_bytes" >= 0
        AND ("capture_first_event_seq" IS NULL OR "capture_first_event_seq" > 0)
        AND ("duration_ms" IS NULL OR "duration_ms" >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_turns_lifecycle_shape" CHECK ((
          "status" = 'queued'
          AND "started_at" IS NULL
          AND "finished_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR (
          "status" = 'running'
          AND "started_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "finished_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR (
          "status" IN (
            'succeeded', 'failed', 'canceled', 'timed_out', 'interrupted'
          )
          AND "finished_at" IS NOT NULL
        )),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_turns_status_codec" CHECK ("status" IN ('queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'canceled', 'timed_out', 'interrupted')),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_turns_capture_state_codec" CHECK ("capture_state" IN ('live', 'complete', 'truncated', 'incomplete')),
  CONSTRAINT "mcp_runtime_test_turns_session_id_mcp_runtime_test_sessions_id_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("session_id") REFERENCES "mcp_runtime_test_sessions" ("id") ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE
)
